name: touch-double-tap
description: A complete pointing hand beside a contact ray and a count of two.
useCase: Touch the same point twice in quick succession.
misuse: Use a label to explain what the gesture changes and how it behaves in the application.

16.reason: The full pointing hand stays separate from the contact ray and count of two.

24.reason: The larger hand, ray and numeral retain clear spacing at the fingertip.
